prompt_fragment: This asset is a top-down hex tile. Compose it for clear map readability, with the terrain filling the frame evenly and no horizon line.
raw_description:
A uniform SATURATED AURORA CYAN flat color field — think #1FC7D4,
the color of public testimony, echo, and exposed memory on a semantic
map. The hue must read as BRIGHT CYAN, not shelf blue, not ocean navy,
not hot-springs green. Clearly distinct from every physical terrain
tile. Fill the ENTIRE 1024x1024 square edge-to-edge with this one
aurora-cyan color corner to corner — NO drawn hex, NO paper border, NO
vignette, NO centered composition, NO symbols, NO eyes, NO figures, NO
script. Only the faintest paint-texture variation within the same cyan
hue. A semantic terrain region-fill swatch, not an illustration.

formatted_prompt.scene: Bold ink-and-watercolor game-map terrain tile rendered in vivid aurora cyan saturated wash, pure flat hue with faint brushstroke texture variation, filling the entire square edge-to-edge, bright cyan punching clear and unambiguous.

subjects.description: Edge-to-edge saturated flat wash, aurora cyan with faint interior paint-texture ripple, uniform hue corner to corner, no breaks or borders.
